name: WHITE FINLAND PINE WET DRY BARREL SAUNA
description: The White Finland Pine Wet Dry Barrel Sauna, has a unique feel and design.  It doubles as an outdoor or indoor sauna. The front porch canopy maximizes seating space.  It seats 6 people inside with room for two more outside.   Assembly can be accomplished in just a few hours and is very easy to do. It comes with an electrical 9.0 kw heater and stainless steel components won't rust or harm the sauna. An advantage to using a barrel sauna is the even heat distribution based on the design and natural air flow.  An electric heater completes the experience with heated rocks, and the accompanying bucket and ladle lets you pour water over the hot stones, boosting temperature and humidity for maximum health and relaxation benefits. The heaters are designed to heat for a maximum of 60 minutes at a time. To heat your sauna for longer than 60 minutes, simply reset the timer for additional time.
